description: This file defines the JSON schema and API specifications for the System plugin in the RDK platform. It includes API method definitions, event descriptions, data models, and references for managing system-level features such as firmware updates, device information, power management, and system configuration.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Collects device details such as MAC addresses, firmware version, build type, etc. (Deprecated, use newer APIs)

methods.name: getDownloadedFirmwareInfo
methods.description: Returns info about current and downloaded firmware versions, and firmware download location.

methods.name: getFirmwareDownloadPercent
methods.description: Returns current number of percentage of firmware download completed.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateInfo
methods.description: Checks for available firmware update information asynchronously.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateState
methods.description: Checks the current state of the firmware update process.

methods.name: getLastFirmwareFailureReason
methods.description: Retrieves the last reason why a firmware update failed.

methods.name: getLastWakeupKeyCode
methods.description: Returns the last wakeup key code.

methods.name: getMacAddresses
methods.description: Fetches various MAC addresses (Ethernet, WiFi, Bluetooth, etc.)

methods.name: getMfgSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the device's manufacturing serial number.

methods.name: getNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Returns whether WakeOnLAN/WakeOnWLAN is supported.

methods.name: getPlatformConfiguration
methods.description: Returns supported features and device info.

methods.name: getPowerState
methods.description: Returns current power state of the device.

methods.name: getPowerStateBeforeReboot
methods.description: Returns power state prior to reboot.

methods.name: getRFCConfig
methods.description: Returns information related to RFC (Remote Feature Control) configurations.

methods.name: getSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns device serial number.

methods.name: getSystemVersions
methods.description: Returns system version details such as STB and receiver versions.

methods.name: getFriendlyName
methods.description: Returns the device's friendly name.

methods.name: getTerritory
methods.description: Gets the configured system territory and region.

methods.name: getTimeZones
methods.description: Retrieves available system time zones.

methods.name: getTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Gets the current configured time zone with its DST information.

methods.name: getWakeupReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for waking from deep sleep.

methods.name: isOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Checks telemetry opt-out status.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Requests device reboot with reason.

methods.name: requestSystemUptime
methods.description: Returns device uptime.

methods.name: setDeepSleepTimer
methods.description: Sets deep sleep timeout period.

methods.name: setFirmwareAutoReboot
methods.description: Enables/disables auto reboot feature.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets system mode for a specific duration.

methods.name: setNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Enables/disables network standby mode (Deprecated).

methods.name: setOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Sets telemetry opt-out status.

methods.name: setPowerState
methods.description: Sets device power state.

methods.name: setFriendlyName
methods.description: Sets the friendly name of the device.

methods.name: setBootLoaderSplashScreen
methods.description: Configures splash screen shown during boot.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Returns build type of flashed image.

methods.name: setTerritory
methods.description: Sets system territory and region.

methods.name: setTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Sets system time zone and DST info.

methods.name: setWakeupSrcConfiguration
methods.description: Sets wakeup source configuration (Deprecated).

methods.name: updateFirmware
methods.description: Initiates firmware update process.

methods.name: uploadLogsAsync
methods.description: Starts background logs upload.

methods.name: abortLogUpload
methods.description: Stops background logs upload.
